## How it works

- [statement] ggml-metal batches matrix multiplication and activation kernels into Metal command buffers, but host-device barrier synchronization causes pipeline stalls if intermediate outputs are queried synchronously. ## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] GDDR7 memory employs PAM3 signaling to transfer 3 bits over 2 cycles per pin, reaching 32 Gbps pin rates and 1024 GB/s aggregate bandwidth across a 256-bit memory controller. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
- [statement] For models fully resident in GDDR7 VRAM (such as Gemma 4 12B at 7.8 GB), sustained memory bus utilization achieves 80-85% of theoretical bandwidth, delivering 85-92 tokens per second. (high confidence) — https://www.jedec.org/standards-documents/docs/jesd239 · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
- [statement] Quantizing KV cache tensors to 4-bit or 8-bit in MLX reduces context memory growth from ~9.0 GB to ~2.5 GB at 64k tokens on 35B parameter models with negligible loss in retrieval recall. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms
- [statement] On memory-bandwidth-bound local hardware like Apple Silicon M5 Max, speculative decoding and MTP boost effective generation throughput by 20% to 40% without modifying output token probabilities. (high confidence) — https://huggingface.co/Qwen · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp
- [statement] Thunderbolt 5 encapsulates PCIe Gen 4 x4 protocol packets with maximum unidirectional real-world payload throughput bounded at approximately 7.0 GB/s. (high confidence) — https://www.thunderbolttechnology.net/tech · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Attempting to stream model parameters across Thunderbolt 5 during autoregressive generation introduces severe PCIe latency stalls that limit generation to sub-1 token/sec for weights exceeding VRAM. (high confidence) — https://www.thunderbolttechnology.net/tech · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Pre-compiling Metal pipeline state objects and caching shader functions avoids runtime compilation pauses during initial context evaluation. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/ggml/src/ggml-metal.metal · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://developer.apple.com/metal/
- [statement] GGUF binary layout enforces 32-byte alignment for all tensor weight arrays, ensuring zero-copy vector instructions (NEON and AVX) execute without unaligned memory access penalties. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
- [statement] K-quants (Q4_K_M) partition weights into super-blocks of 256 weights containing sub-blocks with independent scales and offsets, preserving perplexity comparable to unquantized FP16 at a fraction of memory bandwidth. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/gguf.md · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.md
- [statement] MLX allocates tensor buffers directly into unified memory pages mapped with shared CPU-GPU storage modes, eliminating DMA transfers and serialization overhead. (high confidence) — https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx-examples/tree/main/llms
- [statement] Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) generates candidate future tokens in parallel and verifies them in a single transformer forward pass, amortizing weight memory reads across multiple accepted tokens. (high confidence) — https://huggingface.co/Qwen · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp
- [statement] TTFT scales with prompt length in proportion to compute matrix FLOPs (O(N)), while sequential token generation scales purely with memory bandwidth per token (O(1)). (high confidence) — https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/ml-explore/mlx/blob/main/docs/src/usage/benchmarks.rst
- [statement] Allocating inference memory as wired pages on macOS prevents the virtual memory subsystem from paging model weights to swap disks, ensuring consistent sub-millisecond tensor read latencies. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/unified_memory_architecture · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
- [statement] Pre-allocating static activation workspaces at engine startup eliminates dynamic memory allocation overhead and kernel locks during the generation loop. (high confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/documentation/metal/unified_memory_architecture · keywords: Local Inference Acceleration: Memory Architectures, Metal Kernels, and Latency Optimization · also: https://github.com/tinygrad/tinygrad
